nodes.label: Removal of transaction-association (MBA/Apriori) recommendation
nodes.rationale: Insufficient verified in-platform transaction history; synthetic baskets must not be presented as real buyer behavior.

nodes.label: AHP-TOPSIS multi-criteria ranking method
nodes.rationale: AHP derives weights from pairwise judgments with consistency ratio < 0.10; TOPSIS ranks by closeness to ideal; four benefit criteria: freshness, stock availability, seller reliability, recurrence; thresholds 0.60/0.40 are simulation values.

nodes.label: VISIBILITY_POLICY flag (visibility-v4 vs visibility-ahptopsis-v1)
nodes.rationale: Feature-flagged pilot keeps WVS as default and rollback; AHP-TOPSIS applies to GET /marketplace/products only.

nodes.label: Database push notification outbox with scheduled worker
nodes.rationale: Decouples message/listing writes from external push delivery so the worker can batch, retry, dedupe and aggregate; 500 tokens per batch; invalid tokens disabled.

nodes.label: Seller-scoped recipient rules
nodes.rationale: Paper requires seller-specific listing notification recipients; global broadcast would not satisfy it; followers do not receive private conversation messages.

nodes.label: Persistent conversation threads with REST history and WebSocket delivery
nodes.rationale: Proposal requires real buyer-seller conversation; earlier single question/reply was insufficient; client message ID prevents duplicates on retry.
